_comment: M7-T35 maintenance crew (docs/assets-station.md). Points are in the station's frame (metres); the drum's pivot is (0, 0, -1000). crew: the pool of bots in the cargo bay, peace_min..peace_max out on patrol at once, battle_max repairing at once, repair_hp_s health a bot adds to its area each second, speeds (m/s) and acceleration (m/s^2), spin_s to get on or off the drum, the seeded wait between an area's trips and a patrol's stop (s), and the duck (a repair bot backs off duck_m while a hit landed within duck_radius_m in the last duck_s). roads: the trunk out of the cargo bay past the bow, the climb from its end to the high road at top_y, and the low road at lower_y under the drum. peace: the patrol areas, one bot each at a time: spine (its points), fins (the vanes at x, one of vanes_z, up or down to tip_y, reached at entry_z in front of the first vane), drum (landing and stopping between z[0] and z[1] along the green zone, riding at drum_profile's radius, [station z, radius]), gate (an arm's outer face arm_out_m out, from front_out_m in front of it; depart is the point past the bow the run starts from, detour_m out to the side when the gate is behind). sections: each damage section's work spot (frame) or drum z and radius (boarded from under the drum). mount_offset_m: how far along a grid mount's up a bot works, by kind. The clearance (clearance_m from the drawn hull, the drum's over a whole turn) is tested by tests/unit/test_bot_routes_clear_of_hull.gd.
